column4: A group can satisfy the hypothesis of prop:max-infinite and be MF: the witness is V = MarkedCompression.Vertical conjD conjD_injective, the ascending HNN extension of the affine base. Both carriers exhibit it with a property-(T) subgroup strictly compressed by the stable letter, and MF.

All three clauses. The displayed faithful realization is now proved: realization : V -> GL_4(Q) is injective and its range is exactly the printed set { [[2^k A, v],[0,1]] : A in SL_3(Z), v in Z[1/2]^3, k in Z }, spelled entry by entry in AffineHNNBase.printedMat with Z[1/2] = DyadicRationals.dyadicSubring. Route difference on the separation clause only: residual finiteness is reached in MaxInfiniteConverseRemark by congruence quotients of the integral base at odd moduli rather than by reducing the Z[1/2] matrix model, which is the same separation principle over a smaller ring. Not a gap.

The lamps are necessary for the non-MF conclusion: the carrier conjoins, for the lampless V, the hypothesis of prop:max-infinite (property-(T) subgroup, strict compression by t) with IsOperatorMF V, so that hypothesis alone cannot give non-MF.
